text:
Margo, the savvy detective, has been on the tail of the elusive art thief known as 'The Phantom' for years. In the original story, Margo finally catches The Phantom in a climactic encounter at the Louvre, revealing him to be her long-lost brother. Alternative Ending:

Margo corners The Phantom in the dimly lit corridors of the Louvre, her gun trained on the shadowy figure. Instead of surrendering, The Phantom raises his hands and speaks, his voice distorted by a modulator. "You've got the wrong man, Detective," he says. Margo hesitates, noticing the figure's posture is unfamiliar. She steps closer, pulling off the mask to reveal not her brother, but a skilled impersonator hired by a rival collector to frame The Phantom. The real Phantom, watching from the shadows above, slips away with the stolen masterpiece, leaving Margo to arrest the decoy while the true thief vanishes into the night, one step ahead as always.
